title: Bamboo recipe card holder
text: Bamboo recipe card holder. I am one of those people who still writes recipes that I see on social media - etc in order to save memory on my phone!  I ran out of room in my older, very full holder, so I purchased this one.  It appears to be bamboo, which is sustainable so I like that.  There is a groove on the top of the box that will hold a recipe card if you're in to that ( I cover mine with  protector films and wander around the kitchen with them) and also an interesting knob at the bottom that slides in and out of the bottom of the box.  It's grooved widely and holds your phone if you're watching a media recipe.  Not sure if I will ever use that - but it's interesting.  This box does not come with any dividers, so you'll need to purchase those, your recipes card and protective covers if you like.  It is literally just the box.  Period. It fits a 4x6 card.  I like it and am happy to use it.  Having said all of this, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful. All of my reviews reflect my honest, personal experience with the reviewed item - your experience may be different. I am not influenced by any outside source. I receive/accept NO free products or discounts that are not available to all shoppers- ever. For some reason our shopper ranks are no longer visible - so, to give you a little more info about me, I am a top 50 reviewer (#30 the highest rank achieved). Those numbers used to fluctuate over time - up and down but I noticed that they stopped updating regularly - perhaps to phase them out. It's a shame because it did help you see who has been around the longest and who is a trustworthy reviewer.  I've been doing reviews for over 25 years with Amazon - over 6,000 reviews posted, those reviews have been viewed well over 50,000 times, including well over 24,000 likes. Bottom line, I pay for all my stuff, just like you do.

product_metadata.title: Prosumer's Choice Wooden Recipe Card Desk Organizer with Fold Out Tablet and Smartphone Stand for 4x6 inch Cards | Display Recipes While Cooking | No Assembly Required
features: [STORE HUNDREDS OF CARDS] : Prosumer's Choice recipe box will store culinary index cards up to 4 x 6 inches, along with compatible recipe card organizers. Organizing treasured recipes handed from generation to generation, operating as a tablet holder so you can follow online cooking tutorials.

[DISPLAY YOUR DEVICE] : Mount a smartphone or tablet on your new hybrid recipe box so you can follow online kitchen tutorials or listen to music. With a built-in phone holder, you can follow online cooking tutorials, it holds your smartphone as it plays music for your guests.

[SAFEGUARD RECIPES] : Your durable recipe holder will keep hundreds of culinary index cards safe from spills and stains in your kitchen. Simply slide the notecard into the groove and the notecard’s weight will keep it in place.
[LONG-LASTING WOOD] : Your recipe card box is built from all-natural material that boasts greater hardness than hardwood and higher tensile strength than steel.

[NO ASSEMBLY REQUIRED] : With the Vented design, the raised leg design allows airflow underneath the unit to help resist water buildup starts storing culinary notecards in your kitchen’s new recipe holder with no tools or assembly necessary. Use it straight out of the box.
description: Whether you’re a cook or an aspiring chef, this multipurpose box and device stand from Prosumer’s Choice is an easy, elegant way to organize culinary notes. Packing multiple features, this kitchen accessory can store family recipes handed down from generation to generation, operate as a tablet holder as you follow online cooking tutorials or hold your smartphone as it plays music for your guests. The recipe box also features raised legs to improve airflow. Accommodating 4x6 to 3x5 inch recipe cards and with enough space for up to four hundred index cards, your new cooking companion will be a delight to help you organize. The top of the lid features a groove for displaying notecards upright and hands-free, making recipes easy for you to follow and reducing the risk of staining your notecards. Simply slide the card into the slot and its weight will keep it in place. Use this feature to quickly remove and slide a new index card into the slot as you move onto your next dish. As a storage box, your new accessory is compatible with the dividers from our Prosumer’s Choice Real Wood recipe organizer system, sold separately. Meanwhile, if you prefer following online cooking videos, the slide-out stand at the bottom can hold a tablet or smartphone so you can enjoy hands-free viewing as you follow along, use it to display recipes from your favorite websites or play podcasts as you relax while cooking. Whether you have devoted generations to accumulating recipes or you just started, you deserve a practical, versatile way to organize your collection. This recipe box is a perfect tool or gift for the modern cook, combining style with simplicity and backed by the quality of Prosumer’s Choice.
